title: The Live-Action Blue Lock Movie Releases New Preview
content: Blue Lock wasted little time in becoming one of the biggest sports anime franchises of all time. First arriving in 2018 as a manga from creators Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yusuke Nomura, the series hasn’t just continued to release new chapters to this day; it has also had a major impact on the soccer world.
author: ComicBook

title: Toonami’s Wildest Anime Gets a New Physical Release Ahead of Season 2
content: Since the Summer 2026 anime season is ongoing, several new anime series are being introduced to fans. The year is far from over, but fans have been introduced to dozens of exciting and unique shows. This also includes Rooster Fighter , one of the newest Toonami hits .

title: Inherit the Winds Original TV Anime Casts Ryōhei Kimura
content: The official X/Twitter account for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) revealed on Wednesday that Ryōhei Kimura will play Nagakura Shinpachi ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ).

title: King of the Hill Confirms Major Divorce & One Star Shares Surprising Hopes for the Future (Exclusive)
content: King of the Hill has confirmed a major divorce has been finalized with Season 15 of the animated series now streaming with Hulu this Summer, and one of the stars behind it shared their reaction to it and their surprising hopes for the future.

title: Kim Possible Returns to Disney This Summer, Sparking Revival Theories
content: Disney has had varying levels of success when it comes to bringing back some of their animated classics in brand new ways. While the recent live-action Moana failed to be a hit at the box office, the same couldn’t be said for the live-action takes on The Lion King, Lilo & Stitch , and Beauty and the Beast .

title: Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance Film Reveals 5th Teaser Trailer, Visual, Cast Member
content: The official website for Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance), the all-new feature-length anime film sequel to the Expelled from Paradise film, debuted the new film's fifth teaser trailer and fifth key visual on Wednesday.

title: Demon Slayer Fans Could Get a Major Update on Infinity Castle Part 2 This December
content: It took one year for the first installment of the Demon Slayer : Infinity Castle trilogy to finally confirm a streaming date. While the film initially hit Japanese theatres in July 2025, it made its global debut in September of the same year.

title: One of The Only Slasher Manga is Planning Its Major Comeback
content: Jason Voorhees. Freddy Krueger. Michael Myers. Over the decades, America’s horror genre has given viewers countless icons who have slashed their way into the hearts and minds of audiences worldwide. While Hollywood has a never-ending stream of horror monsters to populate the genre, manga can’t say the same.

title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Just Put Two Fan-Favorite Characters in Serious Trouble
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex has returned this month with its latest monthly chapter, and Chapter 36 features major developments, with two major characters finding themselves in serious trouble. Ever since the battle against Mamushi came to an end, the series has spent the last few chapters expanding its lore.
